title: Enums
explain: An enum gives names to a fixed set of values, such as `Role.Admin`. Numeric enums count up from 0, while string enums keep readable values in your output. Many teams prefer a union of string literals because it adds no runtime code.
exercise: Replace an enum in a small program with a string-literal union and see which code you can delete.
tip: Numeric enum values show up as bare numbers in logs and JSON, which are hard to read. Prefer string members or literal unions for anything you serialize.
